source: MaleCNS v1.0 flat connectome, minimum confidence 0.5 (FlyEM / HHMI Janelia and collaborators, CC BY 4.0)

selection.threat: type in ['LC4', 'LPLC2', 'LC6', 'LC16', 'LPLC1'], the looming-sensitive lobula populations
selection.food: class = gustatory, subclass in ['labellar bristle', 'pharyngeal sensillum', 'taste peg']
selection.readout: every descending neuron reached by the retained graph
selection.bridge: every cell that receives from a selected sensory population and projects onto a descending neuron
selection.edges: every measured directed edge of at least 10 contacts among the retained cells
